summary: Wave 1 GO LIVE (Feed backend, Categories system, Documents counters + signed download links, HomePage live feed) tested end-to-end. 23/23 pytest cases pass (backend). Frontend anonymous shows locked composer + join CTA + 14 chips (Todo + 13 verticals). Authenticated user can create posts (hashtags parsed), react (toggle, picker with 5 kinds), save (toggle), comment (persists in panel), filter by category and restore, share, delete. Regression: /join, /noticias, /videos, /empleos, /empresas, /eventos, /ia, /comunidad, /capital all load without errors. Fixed 2 bugs found (see below).

minor.issue: _doc_to_public omitted download_count/view_count/last_download_at so counters never surfaced through the meta endpoint — FIXED in /app/backend/routes/document_routes.py.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid 'feed-post-comments-{id}' used on both the counter <span> (metrics row) and the comments panel wrapper. querySelector always resolved to the counter span, hiding the panel content from automation. FIXED — renamed counter span to 'feed-post-comments-count-{id}'.

issues: Feed-category-chips only renders group='vertical' categories (13 + 'Todo'); geographic (co, mx, ar, cl, pe, br) never appear as chips. Spec asked for at least 13 verticals — satisfied — but consider a separate geographic chip strip or a country selector for wave 2.

action_items: None blocking. Wave 1 is functionally complete.
Consider surfacing 'feed-post-shares-{id}' counter in the metrics row (currently only reactions/comments/views are displayed textually).
Consider exposing geographic categories as a secondary filter row.
load-more only appears when next_cursor is present; automated test could not exercise it in a fresh DB without seeding 20+ posts — covered in backend test_pagination_and_category_filter instead.
critical_code_review_comments: feed_routes.py:212 — `if not include_hidden or not (viewer and viewer.get('role') == 'admin')` is confusing; the current effect is: always set status='published' unless include_hidden=True AND viewer is admin. Works, but a comment or refactor would help.
feed_routes.py trending pipeline groups by lowercased hashtag but stores/upserts hashtags docs with lowercased tag as well — consistent. Good.

document_routes.py signed link: `_doc_to_public` initially missed the counter fields (fixed here). Consider adding a light unit or contract test to prevent regressions when new fields are added to the DocumentPublic pydantic model.
FeedPostCard.jsx had a duplicate data-testid — general code hygiene: any time the same testid is emitted twice, testing frameworks silently take the first match. Consider a lint rule.

LiveFeed only fetches categories where group='vertical' implicitly — the /api/categories endpoint returns everything unfiltered; the LiveFeed should either pass ?group=vertical to the API or explicitly filter client-side to be predictable if admins add non-vertical categories later.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_feed_categories.py (new — 23 tests covering feed, categories, and document signed-link counters)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_feed_categories.py is stable and self-contained. Uses conftest fixtures (admin_headers, mongo_db) + its own community_session fixture that seeds + cleans a Google-provider session directly in Mongo. Run with: `pytest backend/tests/test_feed_categories.py -o addopts= -v` (the -o addopts= is only needed because pytest.ini enables xdist which is not always available). Wave 2/3 will replace mockData.js in /noticias, /videos, /empleos, /empresas, /eventos, /ia, /comunidad — those pages currently still render mocked content but are being framed as 'planned'.
